sections.title: What Are Cookies?
sections.body: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help websites remember information about your visit. They can be session-based or persistent, and may be set by the website or third-party services.

sections.title: Essential Cookies
sections.body: MedPobeda Group uses essential cookies to support website functionality, user authentication, security, and form submissions. These cookies are necessary for the website to operate correctly.

sections.title: Preference Cookies
sections.body: The website uses preference cookies to remember your language selection, display settings, and website navigation preferences to improve your experience during future visits.

sections.title: Session Cookies
sections.body: Session cookies are temporary and help manage your active session on the website, including login information and form data. These cookies are deleted when you close your browser.

sections.title: Analytics and Performance Cookies
sections.body: If analytics services are enabled, cookies may be used to analyze website usage, understand user behavior, and improve website performance. These cookies are designed to be privacy-respecting.

sections.title: LocalStorage and Similar Technologies
sections.body: The website may use localStorage, sessionStorage, and similar browser technologies to store user preferences, form drafts, and website settings locally on your device.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
sections.body: Third-party services embedded on the website (such as maps, forms, or analytics providers) may set their own cookies. Review their policies for more information.

sections.title: Managing Cookies
sections.body: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or alert you when cookies are being set. Please note that blocking essential cookies may affect website functionality.

sections.title: No Sale of Data
sections.body: MedPobeda Group does not sell personal information or cookie data to third parties. Cookies and tracking data are used for internal website optimization and user experience improvement only.
